question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party and its institutions ahead of the 21st Party Congress scheduled for late 2027, with recent anti-corruption purges targeting senior military and civilian officials reinforcing loyalty and eliminating potential rivals. At age 73, he continues to chair the Central Military Commission, deliver key policy addresses, and shape the 15th Five-Year Plan, while allies occupy top posts and no formal succession process has begun. This structure, built since 2012 and strengthened by the 2018 removal of presidential term limits, underpins the 95.5 percent trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Even so, unforeseen health developments, elite fractures during economic stress, or abrupt leadership maneuvers could still shift outcomes within the narrow window.
